title: Consolidate button/table/chart variants and harmonize tokens across Figma library
creator: Sofia Martinez
description:
Goal: Reduce variant sprawl and token drift for buttons, tables, and chart components in the canonical Figma library so engineers and designers use a single source of truth. This ticket covers: 1) auditing and consolidating component variants (button sizes, tone/state, table density, chart legends), 2) aligning and renaming design tokens used by these components (color, spacing, typography, elevation), 3) cleaning up Auto Layout constraints to ensure responsive behavior when embedded, and 4) publishing a staged Figma library release with migration notes and rollback plan.

Scope details and acceptance criteria:
- Buttons: merge duplicate primary/secondary variants (outline vs ghost were duplicated across frames), standardize states (default / hover / active / disabled) as reusable component states, confirm token usage for color and corner radius. Acceptance: dev tokens JSON matches figma tokens export, no broken instances after swap.
- Tables: reduce density variants to Compact / Regular / Comfortable (remove bespoke customer-tailored variants). Normalize row padding and cell vertical alignment via Auto Layout constraints. Acceptance: product teams confirm table snapshots in Confluence match expectations and no layout regressions in two downstream screens.
- Charts: centralize color tokens for series/axis/legend, remove hard-coded hex inside chart components, add explicit legend variants for stacked vs grouped bars. Acceptance: chart stories use tokenized palette and pass visual diff checks.
- Tokens: complete token rename map and migration script for design-token export used by frontend. Acceptance: tokens exported to repo include version bump and migration notes.

Out-of-scope: full redesign of any component, platform code changes beyond consuming token exports and published figma library.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Breaking existing product instances in open files. Mitigation: create a 'migration' branch of the library file, run swap-runs on a representative set of files (see Links), and provide a rollback file.
- Risk: Token naming differences causing build failures. Mitigation: produce token rename map and quick-fix script for engineering to run as pre-deploy step.

Deliverables:
- Figma file: "Library (migration branch)" with consolidated variants and cleaned Auto Layout.
- Token export JSON and rename map in repo.
- Confluence migration guide and rollback instructions.
- Release note in design-system channel and tag in Figma publish.
updates: 2026-02-22: Kickoff meeting with Design, Platform, and Frontend. Agreed on target variant schema for buttons (3 sizes x 4 states x 3 tones = canonical set). Action: Marcus to produce variant matrix by 2026-02-26.

2026-02-26: Variant matrix delivered. Found ~28 button variants across files; proposed consolidation to 9 canonical variants. Decision: keep 'link' button as a separate component. Marcus started pruning duplicates in migration branch.

2026-03-03: Auto Layout audit completed for table rows. Identified two patterns where fixed height frames cause clipping when fonts scale. Change: convert cell containers to vertical Auto Layout with min/max constraints. Added samples to migration branch for review.

2026-03-05: Token audit with Engineering (Liam Chen). Chart colors used three hard-coded palettes; consolidated to token set `chart/series/{primary,secondary,tertiary}` and `chart/axis` tokens. Engineering requested adding semantic aliases for color blindness variants. Added aliases in token map.

2026-03-08: Internal design review with Ava Patel and Priya Nair. Feedback: increase button touch target for 'compact' to improve accessibility; adjusted Auto Layout padding. Approved changes for publishing. Action: finalize token rename map and export.

2026-03-11: Ran swap instances script on 12 representative product files; 2 minor overrides remained (icon sizing in legacy component). Created follow-up sub-issue DES-9099 for icon-size overrides and update PR to component kit. Preparing Figma publish.
2026-03-12: Prepared release notes and migration guide. Scheduled library publish for 2026-03-18 during low-impact window. Notified stakeholders and created rollback file.
